notes.title: 2.0.0 Extra Chapter Part 1 Demo - Steam Beta
notes.content:
Hey rahscal broarmy!
I'm here to deliver sudden news about a Demo! A demo for Extra Chapter Part 1!

Rightclick on Properties and under Betas you will see a field for a code. Type "istinkofparsee", all lowercase letters and you should be able to download the Demo.

Remember that the Password for the Extra Chapter is separate from this one. You already got that password from beating the game (I hope?)

If not the demo isn't just the Extra Chapter. The maingame has also been tweaked severely as well.
Unfortunately I cannot guarantee your old saves will be compatible with this demo and you'd need to restart completely to experience the new things I changed in the maingame. I also cannot guarantee that the current main game is stable, due to me tinkering with it so much and testing so little, so there's also that. However the Extra Chapter should be all stable.

Hope you have fun!

notes.title: Social media and the future
notes.content:
On the 19th of march Reimus Awesome Holiday is gonna turn 2 years old. This anniversary date is based on the date I uploaded the Game to Gamejolt. I will not make a separate anniversary date for the Steam release, sorry. The 19th of march will be the official release date.
To celebrate, I intend to do nothing... nothing but share my happiness that people played my Game. Thank you :)

Anyway, as the title suggests I made a social media account for all things based around Reimus Awesome Holiday and the upcoming Extra Chapter Update. As well as funky garbage like talking about random trivia of the game and showcasing fan content.
The only social media I use is Twitter. So for the unfortunate not using Twitter... good, you're better off. But for those that do, here's the link to the official Twitter account: https://twitter.com/AwesomeReimus
I will also update on the Extra Chapter developments here, but only if there's a lot to show for it. For smaller stuff, you refer to the official Twitter account.

I may or may not do another announcement on the 19th. Depends whether I have something worthwhile to share. (Probably not)

Have an awesome day, my Rah-scals!
